page0.text:
—I can't do it.
The pain from last night springs to mind.
I was terrified by the indescribable agony and unavoidable death.
But, more than that...
I'm afraid of what I'll do once I set this arm free.

page1.text:
"...No, Tohsaka. I can't take this cloth off. There will be no going back if I do."
I give her a firm answer, fighting down the terror.
And...

page2.text:
"Well done. Yeah, it would be a big problem if you were willing to take it off so easily."
Tohsaka seems very happy, even though I said no.

page3.text:
"...? But I said no, Tohsaka."
"I know. Sorry, but that was just a test.
You have a dangerous habit of taking risks, so I wanted to drive the nail home. If you had said yes, I would've tied up your hands and feet."

page4.text:
"A test... you were testing me, Tohsaka?"
"Ah... Yeah, I wanted to know how you feel, Shirou.
Look, I said earlier that I'd never make you use Archer's arm. Meaning that I wouldn't make you take off the shroud.

page5.text: I know how this sounds right after I was trying to test you, but never say that you're going to take off the shroud again. Once you do, there's no going back."
